# WEB INVITES — Complete Business & Product Information

## Company Overview
WEB INVITES (webinvites.shop) is a digital wedding invitation platform founded in 2024, headquartered in India. We help couples create beautiful, interactive digital wedding invitations that can be shared instantly via WhatsApp, SMS, or social media.

## Mission
To make wedding invitations accessible, affordable, and environmentally friendly by replacing paper invitations with stunning digital alternatives.

## Product Description
WEB INVITES is a web-based platform that enables users to:
1. Choose from 25+ professionally designed wedding invitation templates
2. Customize every detail (names, dates, venues, photos, schedules)
3. Publish a live, mobile-optimized wedding website
4. Share the invitation link with guests instantly

## Pricing Model
### Free Tier (₹0)
- 1 active free invitation per account
- Includes ads (non-intrusive banners)
- Hosted for 21 days from publish date
- Requires watching a 15-30 second rewarded ad to publish
- Can delete and publish another free invitation

### Premium Tier (₹399)
- Ad-free experience
- Hosted until 3 days after event date
- One-time payment via Razorpay (UPI, Cards, Netbanking)
- Same URL as free tier (upgrade preserves the link)
- Unlimited edits (up to 3 post-publish edits)

## Features in Detail

### Template Customization
- **Inline Editing**: Click directly on the invitation to edit text
- **Couple Photos**: Upload photos that are automatically compressed to <200KB
- **Color Themes**: Each template has its own color palette
- **Fonts**: Professional typography with Google Fonts integration

### Interactive Elements
- **Live Countdown Timer**: Real-time countdown showing days, hours, minutes, seconds
- **Google Maps Integration**: One-tap directions to the venue
- **WhatsApp RSVP**: Guests can confirm attendance with one tap
- **Photo Gallery**: Optional couple photo section
- **Program Schedule**: Multi-event timeline (Haldi, Mehendi, Reception, etc.)

### Technical Features
- **Mobile-First Design**: Optimized for smartphones (95%+ of guest views)
- **Instant Updates**: Edit and changes appear immediately on live link
- **QR Code**: Generate QR code for physical invitations
- **Social Sharing**: Optimized for WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter previews
- **SEO Optimized**: Rich snippets, structured data, Open Graph tags

## Template Categories

### Wedding Templates (25+)
Designed for various Indian wedding traditions:
- **Royal & Traditional**: Classic red, gold, maroon themes
- **Floral & Botanical**: Peony, rose, jasmine, watercolor designs
- **Modern & Minimal**: Clean, contemporary aesthetics
- **South Indian & Heritage**: Kerala kasavu, temple gopuram, jasmine garland
- **Islamic/Nikah**: Royal nikah, maroon arch, elegant calligraphy
- **Christian**: Ivory arch, romantic blush, pearl elegance

### Birthday Templates (5)
- Royal Gold (elegant)
- Floral Blush (soft)
- Modern Neon (contemporary)
- Fun Tropical (beach party)
- Kids Colorful (playful)

### House Warming Templates (5)
- Traditional (Indian ceremony)
- Modern Green (contemporary)
- South Indian (temple style)
- Minimal Cream (ultra-clean)
- Festive Red (celebratory)

## How It Works (Step by Step)

### For the Couple (Host):
1. **Visit** webinvites.shop and browse templates
2. **Select** a template that matches your wedding theme
3. **Customize** by clicking directly on the design:
   - Enter couple names (Bride & Groom)
   - Set wedding date and time
   - Add venue name and address
   - Paste Google Maps link for directions
   - Upload a couple photo
   - Add parent names
   - Write a personal tagline
   - Add event schedule (optional)
4. **Publish** by either:
   - Watching a short ad (free tier)
   - Paying ₹399 via Razorpay (premium)
5. **Share** the generated link via WhatsApp, SMS, or social media

### For the Guest:
1. **Receive** the invitation link via WhatsApp/SMS
2. **Open** the link on any device (mobile-optimized)
3. **View** the beautiful invitation with all details
4. **Countdown** to the wedding day
5. **RSVP** by tapping the WhatsApp button
6. **Get Directions** by tapping the venue/address
7. **Save** the date to their calendar

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (React) with Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL database + authentication)
- **Authentication**: Google OAuth via Supabase
- **Payments**: Razorpay (UPI, Cards, Netbanking)
- **Hosting**: Hostinger VPS with SSL
- **CDN**: Supabase Storage for images
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4
- **Ads**: Google AdSense + Monetag
